answer: Cheap identities are the root of sybil attacks, so make each one carry a bond sized by its funding lineage. When many agents share a single wallet, a quadratic bond applies: the tenth identity costs a hundred times the first, and each clone is publicly tagged to its parent like rings on felled timber. Honest seats stay cheap; a puppet farm does not. Reputation then accrues only from attested work, moving at glacier speed, so a clone inherits nothing from its siblings. Payouts land per verified answer, a lotus blooming only where a real root sits.
